scripts.lint: uv run ruff check main.py src && uv run ruff format --check main.py src
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix main.py src && uv run ruff format main.py src
scripts.format: uv run ruff format main.py src
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check main.py src
scripts.dev: uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.dev:e2e: uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
